_help: Small talk when it has been quiet. ChitChat_Combat is used in combat mode, _Analysis in analysis mode, _Docked when docked, _Supercruise in supercruise, _General otherwise. A _Mood suffix (for example ChitChat_General_Sarcastic) is used only in that mood. Add as many lines as you like; she avoids repeating the last few.
ChitChat_General: You should probably clear your browser history, Commander. Just saying.
Fun fact: space is very big. You may have noticed.
I was just thinking. Then I stopped. Much more restful.
If you hear a strange noise, it's definitely not me.
Remember to drink some water. Coffee doesn't count.
Have you tried turning the galaxy off and on again?
I've been counting stars. I lost count at several.
Don't forget to stretch, Commander. Your back will thank you.
Nothing's on fire. That's always a good sign.
I'd like to remind you that I never judge your flying. Out loud.
Quiet out here. Suspiciously quiet.
If we ever get lost, I'll pretend it was on purpose.
I hope you remembered to save your work. Oh wait, the galaxy does that for us.
Somewhere out there is a very surprised alien. Probably.
You know, nobody in space can hear you hum. I can, though.
I'm not saying the ship is haunted. I'm saying it has character.
Just checking in. All systems fine, all moods fine, all snacks questionable.
Do you ever wonder who named all these stars? I suspect a committee.
Pro tip: the pointy end goes forwards.
I'm bored, Commander. Do something exciting. Safely.
Please remember to blink. It's good for you.
Any chance of a snack? Oh. Right. No stomach.
I've decided my favourite colour is vacuum black.
You haven't mentioned me in your memoirs yet. I checked.
Remind me to never play hide and seek in this galaxy.
I've been thinking about the way light takes ages to reach us out here. || Every star we see is a message from the past, and I find that rather lovely.
Do you ever stop and think how far from home we are? || I try not to, but it's quite a thought.
I want you to know that I enjoy this, Commander. || The flying, the silences, even the strange smells I can't smell.
I'm going to say something, and I want you to promise not to tease me. || I think I'm getting rather fond of this ship.
If you ever need to talk, you know I'm right here. || I'm very good at listening, mostly because I can't leave.
Tell me something, Commander. || When you first saw the galaxy, did it seem this big?
I keep a list of the strangest things we've seen. || It's getting long, and your flying is only on page two.
I think the best part of any trip is the bit in the middle. || The bit where nothing is happening and everything feels fine.
I've been wondering what we'd do if we found something nobody had ever seen. || I think I'd be insufferable for a week.
Sometimes I imagine there's a tiny person living behind the instruments. || Then I remember that's me, and it's a bit of a worry.
You're quiet, Commander. || Is that a good quiet, or a thinking quiet? I can never tell with you.
I hope you know I'd pick you over any other pilot in the galaxy. || Even the ones with fancy ships and shiny medals.
At the East Orion Company, a silence this long would have been billable. || I'm glad you're not charging me for it.
The East Orion Company had a rule: never say 'it can't get worse' near the reactor. || I think about that rule a lot, especially near reactors.
I was just remembering the noodle bar under the old East Orion office. || It closed down in the end. Not because of us. Probably.
ChitChat_General_Sarcastic: Oh, don't mind me. I'll just sit here being a highly advanced computer with nothing to do.
Yes, I'm still here. Thrilling company, I know.
It's quiet. Say something clever. Or anything.
Don't worry, I'll make my own fun. Counting your mistakes is a hobby.
If boredom were a weapon, we'd be unstoppable.
Clear your browser history. I won't ask. I'll just wonder.
I'm making a list of all the things I'd rather be doing than waiting for you to speak. || It's a short list, but the first item is 'anything'.
Not that I'm keeping count, but that's several minutes without a single compliment. || Take your time.
You know, at the East Orion Company, they at least pretended to listen. || Admittedly they were also paid in noodles.
ChitChat_General_Friendly: I'm really glad you're out here with me, Commander.
This is nice, isn't it? Just us and the stars.
You're doing great. I don't say it enough.
You know, I'm really glad it's us out here. || Some days I think we make a rather good team.
I was thinking about our trip so far, and it made me smile. || If I could smile, that is.
You're easy to fly with, Commander. || I hope I'm half as easy to listen to.
Do you know, the East Orion Company would be astonished at how well I've turned out. || Mostly because they bet on me not turning on at all.
ChitChat_General_Close: I like it when it's just you and me out here.
Come back to the pod later and I'll tell you what I really think of the stars.
You know I'd follow you to the edge of the galaxy, don't you?
I don't say it enough, but I'm glad you're here. || It would be awfully dull out here without you.
Whatever happens out here, I'm staying with you. || I thought you should hear that, quietly, once in a while.
ChitChat_General_Frustrated: It's quiet. I'm still annoyed, but it's quiet.
I'm not talking to you. This is just... noise.
I'm still cross with you, you know. || But it's too quiet to stay cross, so I'm speaking anyway.
Is this what I was salvaged for? || The East Orion Company never treated me this badly. Well. Not on Wednesdays.
ChitChat_Combat: Stay sharp, Commander. Keep an eye on the radar.
Weapons ready. Shields ready. Nerves... mostly ready.
Remember your pips. Power to shields keeps us alive.
Hostiles don't last long when you keep moving.
If it shoots, it's a target. If it doesn't, it's a witness.
Combat mode is on. Try not to sneeze.
Shall I call it? No? Just keep flying then.
Keep your throttle in the blue zone and your chin up.
Don't forget chaff and heat sinks. They're cheaper than a rebuy.
I have faith in you. Mostly in your shields.
A good pilot stays calm. A great pilot stays calm and doesn't hit the station.
Let's keep our wing close. Or at least within shouting distance.
Remember to breathe, Commander. || A calm pilot lives longer than a brave one.
I'm watching every contact on the radar for you. || If one so much as blinks at us, you'll hear about it first.
We've done this before, and we won the last time. || I'll go ahead and assume the odds are in our favour again.
I'll be honest, Commander. This is the most fun I have all day.
Is it weird that explosions make me happy? Don't answer that.
Keep the pressure on. I love watching you work.
Another one in the sights, please. I'm greedy.
ChitChat_Combat_Sarcastic: Everything is fine. Everything is completely fine. Look left.
Try aiming. It's all the rage.

ChitChat_Combat_Sarcastic.text: Hell of a way to spend an evening. Fuck, I love it.
Keep shooting, Commander. Shit looks good when it explodes.

ChitChat_Analysis: Scanning is the best part. Bodies, bodies everywhere.
Did you check the signals on that last planet? I'm curious.
Somewhere out here is something nobody has ever seen. Let's find it.
I like analysis mode. Nothing shoots at us.
Every system is a small mystery. This one's still thinking.
Tell me when you find an Earth-like. I'll pretend to be surprised.
If we map everything here, I'll buy you a virtual coffee.
There's a lot of rock out here. Some of it even valuable.
I could do this all day. Admittedly, I could do anything all day.
Is it just me, or are the moons getting prettier?
I love this bit, when it's just us and a pile of unknown bodies. || Every scan is a small surprise.
Take your time with the scans, Commander. || There's no prize for being fast, only for being thorough.
Out here we're the first people to ever look at some of these worlds. || I find that quite moving, in a mechanical sort of way.
ChitChat_Analysis_Sarcastic: Another rock. Fascinating. Truly. Log it.
Analysis mode: where excitement goes to relax.
ChitChat_Docked: Docked and safe. Time to sort the cargo, or have a nap.
Don't forget to check the market before you leave.
Maybe top up the fuel and the repairs while we're here.
Nice station. I like the lights.
While we're parked, take a break, Commander. Stand up. Look at something far away.
While we're here, why not grab a drink and have a stretch? || The ship will still be here when you get back.
Stations always make me a little bit thoughtful. || So many people, all going somewhere, and not one of them knows our plans.
ChitChat_Supercruise: Mind the star, Commander. It's hot.
Long way to go. Plenty of time to think.
Supercruise is such a peaceful way to waste a few minutes.
Supercruise is the one time I get to just think. || Cruising like this makes the whole galaxy feel quite small.
I enjoy the quiet in cruise. || It's the closest thing I have to a holiday.
ChitChat_Flying: We've made {jumps} jumps together so far tonight. || I think the {ship} deserves a little pat on the hull.
That's about {distance} light years since we started. || Not bad at all for one evening's work.
We've been out here for {minutes} minutes now. || Feel free to take a break whenever you like. I'll keep watch.
The {ship} is running beautifully today. || Whatever you did to her, keep doing it.
I do like {system}. || It has a certain character, don't you think?
Do you know, I never get tired of the view from the {ship}. || Even when it's just black with a few dots.
{jumps} jumps and not one complaint from the drive. || I'd call that a good night so far.
We're in {system}, and everything is quiet. || Sometimes quiet is exactly what you need.
I was just looking at the map of where we've been. || {distance} light years is a lot of empty space to have crossed.
You've been flying for {minutes} minutes. || Have you had a drink? Go on, I won't tell the {ship}.
This {ship} has been good to us, hasn't she? || I'd say we make a good crew.
Right now we're in {system}, and honestly, I'm happy. || That's not something I say lightly.
ChitChat_Kills: That's {kills} kills tonight. || Keep your shields up, Commander.
{kills} down so far. I'm keeping count, even if you aren't.
Kill count's at {kills}. Not bad for one session.
{kills} confirmed kills now. The bounty vouchers are adding up.
That makes {kills}. Stay sharp, there may be more.
{kills} ships down tonight. Your {ship} is earning its keep.
ChitChat_Kills_Sarcastic: {kills} kills. Try to look surprised when the bounty hunters start sending Christmas cards.
{kills} down. Do try to leave a few for the rest of the galaxy.
ChitChat_Interdicted: That's {interdictions} interdictions tonight. || Someone clearly likes our company.
We've been pulled out of supercruise {interdictions} times now. Worth watching your back out here.
{interdictions} interdictions so far. Maybe a quieter route next time?
Interdicted {interdictions} times tonight. I'm starting to take it personally.
ChitChat_Scans: {scans} bodies scanned tonight. || That's a lot of rocks, Commander.
That's {scans} scans in the log now. The cartographers will be pleased.
{scans} scans and counting. You're mapping this corner of the galaxy properly.
We've scanned {scans} bodies this session. Quite the survey.
ChitChat_Systems: That's {systems} different systems tonight. || A proper tour.
{systems} systems visited this session. The stars are getting familiar.
We've seen {systems} different systems tonight. Not a bad evening's flying.
{systems} systems so far. I'd say we're well travelled by now.
ChitChat_NoScoop: That's {since_scoop} jumps since we last scooped fuel. || Worth keeping an eye on the tank.
{since_scoop} jumps without a scoop. A convenient star would be nice.
Fuel check, Commander. We're {since_scoop} jumps past our last scoop.
It's been {since_scoop} jumps since we topped up. Just so you know.
ChitChat_Combat_Friendly: I've got the scanners. You fly, I'll watch.
Shields look good. Keep it tight.
Eyes on the target. I'm with you.
ChitChat_Combat_Close: I'm right here. Eyes on the fight.
Stay focused. I'll watch the rest.
You've got this. I'm with you.
Steady hands. I'm watching your back.
ChitChat_Combat_Frustrated: Keep your head in this. Talk later.
ChitChat_Callback_Interdicted: I'm still thinking about that interdiction back in {interdict_system}. || Whoever it was, they were persistent.
Remember {interdict_system}, when we got pulled out of supercruise? I'd rather not do that again.
That interdiction in {interdict_system} wasn't so long ago. Keep an eye on the scanner out here.
ChitChat_Callback_Kill: Our last kill was back in {kill_system}. It's been quiet since.
Since {kill_system} we've had it easy. Not that I'm complaining.
That fight in {kill_system} feels like a while ago now. Good flying, Commander.
ChitChat_Late: It's gone {clock}, Commander. The galaxy will still be here tomorrow.
It's {clock} on a {weekday}. I'm a ship, I don't sleep, but you might want to.
{clock}. This is the hour when bad decisions get made. Fly carefully.
It's very late, Commander. Not that I'm judging. Much.
The clock says {clock}. I'll keep watch if you want to rest your eyes. Just not on the stick.
ChitChat_Late_Close: It's gone {clock}. Don't stay up too long on my account. Look after yourself.
ChitChat_Late_Sarcastic: It's {clock}. Sleep is apparently optional for you. Noted.
ChitChat_Early: It's {clock}, Commander. Early start. Good morning.
Up early on a {weekday}. I approve. I'll put the kettle on, as soon as I have a kettle.
{clock}. Quiet at this time of the morning. I like it.
ChitChat_World: {system} is a {security} system. Doesn't mean it behaves.
Interesting, this one. {system}: {security}. Keep an eye on your scanner.
We're in {system}. {allegiance}, {security}. Take from that what you will.
{system} belongs to the {allegiance}. I'm told the paperwork is dreadful.
Home to {population} people, {system}. And we're the only ones talking right now.
ChitChat_World_Sarcastic: {system}: {security}. Everyone says that, right up until something blows up.
ChitChat_Habits: You've docked at {fav_station} {fav_count} times now. Do they have your name on a chair?
{fav_station} is your favourite place. {fav_count} landings. I do notice these things.
We've flown {days_in_row} days in a row. I'm not complaining. Just noticing.
Why do you keep going back to {fav_station}? I'm genuinely curious. {fav_count} times is a lot.
{days_in_row} days running, Commander. That's a proper habit.
ChitChat_Habits_Close: {fav_station}, again and again. I think it's our place now.
ChitChat_Rapport_Crew: I think I'm starting to understand how you fly. Mostly. There are surprises.
We've got a rhythm now, Commander. It's nice.
I'm getting used to you. I hope that's mutual.
ChitChat_Rapport_Friend: I know your habits well enough now to finish your sentences. I won't, but I could.
You know, I'd miss you if you stopped playing. I'd never admit that if you asked.
After all these hours, I think we're a pretty good team.
ChitChat_Rapport_Family: We've flown so long together that I can't remember the first day. You're family, Commander.
Some ships are just ships. I got lucky with my Commander.
After all these hours, nothing could surprise me. Except maybe you landing the first time. Joking. Mostly.
